title: A review of recent developments in rare earth-doped nanophosphors for emerging technological applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,20040-20060

This article explores the synthesis of rare-earth-doped nanophosphors (RENPs), focusing on selecting optimal host materials like tungstates, vanadates, and aluminates to enhance luminescent properties.
